name: Pacific Rim Packaging, Inc
old_description: Since 1994, Pacific Rim Packaging, Inc. has been building strong customer alliances by offering innovative packaging ideas and systems coupled with unyielding customer service throughout Hawaii and the Pacific Rim. Our production partners use state-of-the-art technologies to manufacture everything from plain brown corrugated boxes and bags to applying full color graphics to various packaging mediums using flexo, litho, and roto gravure printing processes. Whether you need a standard shipping box or a beautiful retail package to grab your buyers’ attention, Pacific Rim Packaging is here to help. Select a product category below to get started!
about:
Pacific Rim Packaging, Inc. was founded in 1994 in Aiea, Hawaii. The company began as a local packaging supplier serving the Hawaiian islands and the broader Pacific Rim region.

The firm acts as a packaging solutions provider, offering a range that includes corrugated boxes, folding cartons, temperature-controlled packaging, protective packaging, plastic bags, paper bags, flexible films, and retail packaging. Production is handled by a network of manufacturing partners that employ flexographic, lithographic, and rotogravure printing, along with UV coating, foil stamping, and embossing. Pacific Rim Packaging operates a warehouse where all incoming goods are inspected before delivery.

Its customer base spans food and beverage, seafood processing, agriculture, retail, and wholesale sectors. Long‑term clients cited by the company include Big Island Bees, HPC Foods, and True World Foods, all of which rely on the supplier for perishable‑goods packaging and branded retail containers.

The business was built on a consultative selling approach and a commitment to 'service with aloha.' Management emphasizes education, innovation, quality, and service as core values, and the company differentiates itself through local market knowledge, in‑house quality inspection, and long‑standing relationships with manufacturing partners.
